# Phian Infotec

> Phian Infotec is a 360-degree branding and marketing agency founded in 2012 by Debojyoti Ghosh, headquartered in Nagpur, Maharashtra, with an office in Kolkata, West Bengal. One senior team plans brand strategy, content, media, web, search and PR together for businesses across Central and East India.

Contact: info@phianinfotec.com, +91 77098 09577. Nagpur HQ: 5, Pannase Layout, Indraprastha Nagar, Swavalambi Nagar, Nagpur 440022.

## Services

- [Brand Strategy and Identity](https://www.phianinfotec.com/brand-strategy): research, positioning, naming and identity systems
- [Content and Creative](https://www.phianinfotec.com/content-creative): social, campaigns, film and AI-assisted production
- [Media and Performance](https://www.phianinfotec.com/media-performance): Meta, Google and WhatsApp lead funnels
- [Web, Tech and CRM](https://www.phianinfotec.com/web-tech-crm): websites, landing pages and CRM systems
- [Search and Intelligence](https://www.phianinfotec.com/search-intelligence): SEO, AI search visibility and reporting
- [PR and Reputation](https://www.phianinfotec.com/pr-reputation): media, founder profiles and reviews
